preprocessing: Pinned loader: RGB 640x480 -> Pillow LANCZOS 574x434, divisible by14, no crop. RGB-only, no supplied calibration/poses/depth; bf16 autocast. Resizing differs from full-resolution classical baseline and is reported, not treated as equal-compute A/B.
evaluation: Same fixed six RGB timestamps and existing 20ms TUM translation evaluator; GT opened only after prediction complete. Full denominator; Sim3 fitted scale is not recovered physical scale. Retain incomplete rows and all raw tensors.
failure_policy: One forward per source, one seed/configuration; no retry, resampling, GT tuning or best-of selection. Entire cohort stays three; external GPU work blocks execution.
